Warnings.DISTINCTIONS_SET_MISSING: No trait set has the distinctions role. You can still save. Without distinctions, most pools lose a die; Handbook p. 66 suggests making up for it, for example with a further prime set or with other traits that add dice.
Warnings.PRIME_SETS_TOO_FEW: Fewer than two trait sets have the prime role. You can still save. The Handbook advises at least two prime sets, since they give most rolls their basic dice (pp. 26, 47).
